body.purpose: Accessible operational copy and long-form reading.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Short color and transform feedback only; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Contact Button
components.description: The primary route to a role conversation.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-foreground-strong); color: var(--color-surface); padding: 12px 20px; font: 700 14px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Reading Button
components.description: A low-noise route into the writing series.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { border: 1px solid var(--color-divider); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-foreground-strong); padding: 12px 20px; font: 700 14px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-foreground-strong); background: var(--color-accent-soft); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: A scan-friendly production outcome in a ruled list.
components.html:
Sales Copilot

Built reusable admin primitives across a production module.

130K+ records · ~190ms page requests
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: grid; gap: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 24px 0; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 400 16px/1.6 var(--font-sans); } .ds-evidence strong { color: var(--color-foreground-strong); font-weight: 700; } .ds-evidence p { margin: 0; } .ds-evidence span { color: var(--color-accent); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Writing List Item
components.description: A ruled article link that gives title, explanation, and reading time equal structure.
components.html: 01React Rendering and Reconciliation Internals45 min read
components.css: .ds-writing-item { display: grid; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 20px 0; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-writing-item span { color: var(--color-accent); font: 700 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-writing-item b { color: var(--color-foreground-strong); font: 500 24px/1.2 var(--font-serif); transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-writing-item em { color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 14px var(--font-sans); font-style: normal; } .ds-writing-item:hover b { color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-writing-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Portfolio Navigation
components.description: Compact identity and direct navigational choices, divided from content by a rule.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 20px 0; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 600 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav strong { color: var(--color-foreground-strong); margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:last-child { color: var(--color-foreground-strong); text-decoration: underline 2px var(--color-accent); text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A proof-led personal portfolio and technical writing system. It uses calm structure, real metrics, and a dedicated reading hierarchy to express rigor without corporate gloss.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral marks actions, proof, and focused attention—not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Mechanism Rule
rules.body: Every strong claim should be followed by a concrete mechanism or metric.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Rules organize proof and never frame generic card content.

dos: Use coral only to direct attention.
donts: Do not use generic template portfolio patterns.
Do not use flashy motion showcases.
